player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ken agilaro {colour} ({piece}) ed saray Othello.
Say tungtungan mo esem na mas dakel so pieza na kulay mo ed tabla diad end na game.
Diad turn mo, ilukas mo so pieza para makapaligaya so aduana o mas dakel a pieza na kalaban mo - diad any direction (horizontal, vertical, o diagonal) - between new mo a pieza ken say another a pieza mo.
All flanked opponent pieces mapalit so kulay mo.
Provide your move diad format '[row, col]'.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} Anggapoy valid iran galaw - nayarin kaukolan mon i-skip.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} Anggapoy balibalin galaw. Nayarin kaukolan mon i-skip so sakey a move.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say move et nepeg ya onkana ed [row, col].
invalid_move.illegal: Iligal ya inyalis. Makatunongan iran iyalis: {valid}

game_action.skipped: Say manlalaban {pid} so kaukolan ya ag-onla ed turno to.

game_message.must_skip: Player {pid} ({piece}) walang valido a pagilian ken kailangan umalsa.
